title: AWARE 2.0 RLM configuration
description: Declarative config for invoking the RLM (Recursive Language Model) primitive inside AWARE. Read by src/config/rlm.cjs at boot (planned). Validated by the A1.1 bring-up smoke test. Defaults live in config/rlm.yaml; prose lives in docs/rlm.md.

$schema.description: Optional reference to the schema file. Not validated.

rlm.description: Top-level RLM namespace. All 10 fields are required by policy: an RLM adapter that silently defaults a field has no way to know whether the operator ever saw the value.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the adapter short-circuits and never invokes rlm(). Audit logs the disablement.

budgetUsd.description: Per-call USD cap. null = no cap (cost recorded but never enforced). Number = opt in to enforcement.

tree.description: Default tree shape for recursive decomposition. Defaults (maxDepth=2, branching=3, K=4) yield 9 leaves.

maxDepth.description: Max recursion depth. Capped at 5 to prevent absurd costs even without budget enforcement.

K.description: Top-level K (number of children the root spawns).

preferParallel.description: OOS for v1; schema still types it so a future migration does not have to widen the schema.

tools.description: REPL tool whitelist. AST filter enforces it on leaf-emitted code.

allowed.description: Whitelisted REPL tools. 7-tool surface per SPEC §11; vec_search and len are load-bearing for the AWARE retrieval context.

workspaceDir.description: Absolute path to the REPL workspace root. All REPL path operations are confined to this directory.

decompositionFormat.description: Decomposition prompt format. Only plain-text is valid for v1; json is permitted for forward migration but currently unused.

sandbox.description: REPL sandbox policy. enforcement=required refuses any rlm() call without an active sandbox.

enforcement.description: Sandbox enforcement level. Only required is safe for v1; advisory and disabled are documented as unsafe.

privilegeDrop.description: Whether the REPL subprocess drops setuid/setgid before exec.

opFilter.description: Leaf-emitted code op filter. ast-whitelist uses Python ast + JS acorn.

seccomp.description: Whether the library's seccomp profile (blocks socket/connect/accept/recv/send) is active.

landlock.description: Landlock availability. linux-only is the v1 default; macOS has no landlock and is supported-with-caveats.

wallClockSeconds.description: Per round-trip wall-clock cap, in seconds.

audit.description: Audit-log canonical field names. The const fields are F-008 protected: no override.

component.description: Audit component name. F-008 — no override.

kindNode.description: Per-tree-node audit kind discriminator. F-008 — no override.

costRecorded.description: When cost is recorded in the audit log. always records regardless of budget enforcement; on-budget records only when enforcement is on.

redactFields.description: Audit-log fields stripped before persistence. Unknown fields fail validation so the redaction surface stays explicit.

fewShotExamples.description: In-context few-shot examples. Hard-coded to 0 for v1; deferred to v2.

killSwitch.description: When true, the adapter refuses to invoke rlm() and audit-logs the refusal. Lazy getter.
